ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var limit = payload.limit as Number default 200 var offset = payload.offset as Number default 0 var sfId = payload.sfId default null --- { query: "SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, PersonEmail, Phone, AccountNumber, TaxId__c, Status__c FROM Contact " ++ (if (sfId != null) "WHERE Id = '" ++ sfId ++ "' " else "") ++ "LIMIT " ++ limit as String ++ " OFFSET " ++ offset as String }
